residual_findings.closure_note: V1.49 P0 W-1 fix wave (commit 7da35dd5, merged at c4b4500f): DAO-level split — IllegalTransition { from, to } + InvalidEnum { field, value, allowed } added alongside retained ConstraintViolation (other callers in works.rs / inspiration_items.rs / create-path validators / handlers/works.rs). Handler remaps: IllegalTransition→INVALID_TRANSITION (422), InvalidEnum→INVALID_INPUT (422), with structured messages (no 'findings' table-name leak) and tracing::warn! on both arms. Renamed test findings_lifecycle_rejects_unknown_status_value→findings_lifecycle_rejects_unknown_status_with_invalid_input. Added 2 new tests: findings_lifecycle_distinguishes_invalid_transition_from_invalid_enum (4 cases) + findings_lifecycle_rejects_sql_injection_style_status (qc2 S-2 rolled). 50 hermetic tests pass. Targeted re-review: qc-specialist Approve @ 1a3a3646; qc-specialist-2 Approve @ fcf6cf95.

residual_findings.title: CLI `creator run` client-side findings fetch still uses `?status=open`, missing V1.49 `triaged` actionable set
residual_findings.note: V1.49 P0 widened DAO SQL + auto_chain consumer; CLI client-side fetch at run.rs::assemble_open_findings_block still hard-codes `?status=open`. Suggested fix at V1.50: extend Local API ListFindingsQuery.status to accept comma-separated list (or add `:actionable` endpoint) + update CLI to pass `open,triaged` + CLI integration test. Auto-chain path (production) is unaffected — already uses widened DAO filter.
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.50 P-last T1: (1) FindingListFilters.status now accepts comma-separated values; list_findings DAO branches to a dynamic IN (?, ...) query when the value contains a comma (tokens validated against VALID_STATUSES → LocalDbError::InvalidEnum on bad token). (2) list_findings_handler maps InvalidEnum → 422 INVALID_INPUT. (3) assemble_open_findings_block now sends ?status=<ACTIONABLE_FINDING_STATUSES joined by ','> — reads the canonical constant from nexus-local-db::findings. New integration test findings_list_filter_by_comma_separated_status covers single-status regression, actionable set membership, whitespace tolerance, and unknown-token rejection.
